items.title: File Einspruch against the tax assessment
items.quote: Legen Sie ihn innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Beispielau ein, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Bescheid dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday); no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date is stated, so the posting day is the printed letter date, 19.11.2026. Tax-office delivery rule: delivered on the 4th day after posting, counting calendar days from the day after posting (19.11 not counted): 20,21,22,23 Nov → delivery (Bekanntgabe) = Mon 23.11.2026. 23.11.2026 is a Monday, not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday, so no shift under §108 Abs.3 AO is needed for the delivery day itself. One-month Einspruch period per §355 Abs.1 AO, §108 Abs.1 AO with §188 Abs.2 BGB: the day of delivery (23.11.2026) is not counted; the period ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NW (the office's Land), so the deadline does not shift.
